_comment: PDK version pin for the sky130-ldo sim harness (issue #2).
variant           sky130 flavor directory to use (A/B differ in metal stack)
open_pdks_commit  the volare version hash every record is pinned against
default_pdk_root  fallback PDK_ROOT if neither $PDK_ROOT nor `volare path` resolve
ngspice_lib       the combined ngspice model-library include, relative to the variant dir
xschem_pdk_rc     the PDK's own xschemrc, relative to the variant dir
process_corners   the MOS/BJT/resistor-skew corner sections that actually exist in
ngspice_lib -- verified against the .lib sections of
libs.tech/combined/sky130.lib.spice for this pinned commit. Same
pin as sky130-bandgap (2AMLogic/sky130-bandgap), so this list is
reused unmodified: tt/ss/ff/sf/fs are the standard MOS corners,
ll/hh are the resistor/capacitor-only skew corners. Additional
sections (hl/lh, the *_mm mismatch sections, mc Monte Carlo)
exist in the library and can be added here once an experiment
